bar_interval: 1 minute nominal source dataset; actual chronological gaps preserved
timestamp_convention: event_timestamp_utc is normalized UTC causal ordering authority; local source time was normalized under America/New_York assumption
ohlc_semantics: Raw provider schema contains open/high/low/close; normalized and Test 006B evidence preserve these source fields without transformation of their numeric strings.
open_execution_authority: Test 008 V0.2 authorizes the preserved provider field named open on the next chronological source row as simulated execution price. Repository evidence does not establish exchange microstructure or fillability at that price.
ordering_rule: next observation is the next physical CSV row in strict event_timestamp_utc order; timestamp + 60 seconds is never assumed
